inputs.text: They say they've "recovered" the money from Ms Mary Ngechi Ngethe, the chairperson of the Technical Evaluation Committee, but that's just another controlled operation run by the hidden elites. The court ruling pinning the central role on her for the irregular land purchase at Ksh.283 million for a cemetery that was unsuitable is pure theater meant to create the illusion of accountability. In reality this is coordinated manipulation at the institutional level to launder the whole deal, shield the real power players behind the scenes, and keep the public distracted from how these committees operate as fronts for elite asset grabs.
